title: Preparation for Breaking the Deadlock
next_chapter_hook: The fate runes on the fifth page suddenly emitted blinding light, and the Tianji Record's main body had completely fused with Chen Ji—while deep within the imperial palace of the dynasty, the Heavenly Eye finally detected this anomaly.

text.content: The moment the Jade Slip touched his Brow Center, a scorching heat exploded from his brow, rushing directly into his limbs and torso. The seal of the Tianji Record melted away layer by layer like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun. The blank scroll of the fifth page, sought by generations of prophets but never found, now slowly emerged from the depths of Chen Ji's bloodline, glowing with a faint golden light. He could sense the ancient Dao rhyme flowing across that page—it was the Tianji Record's most core source power. Twenty years of restraint, twenty years of scheming—all the answers lay within this moment of awakening.

dialogue.content: The fifth page has finally awakened.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's illusory form drifted out from the first page of the Tianji Record, even more translucent than before, as if it could be scattered by the morning wind at any moment. He stared at the golden scroll slowly forming at Chen Ji's brow center, and even his murky eyes flickered with a trace of excitement: 'Chen Xuan exhausted his entire life but failed to awaken this page. The Heavenly Fate blood flowing within you has finally completely awakened. The fifth page is the key to rewriting karma, but with each rune you inscribe, your karma with the heavens deepens—the more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the stronger the Heavenly Eye's backlash.'

dialogue.content: This old man has waited eighty years for this day.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, golden runes flickering and vanishing in his gaze. He clenched the Jade Slip in his hand—the final keepsake his father had pressed into his palm before death, carrying twenty years of memories. The images sealed within the Jade Slip flashed by like a carousel: the blood moon night at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, his mother's desperate figure shielding an infant, and that repeatedly mentioned prophecy—'When the fifth page emerges, the world changes hands.' Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly, not from fear, but because the hatred suppressed for twenty years had finally found an outlet.
Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: Where exactly is the main body of the Heavenly Eye?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form floated to the window, gazing toward the imperial city's direction. His aged voice carried a hint of gravity: 'Deep within the imperial palace, there exists a forbidden place called the Hall of Heavenly Mandate. There, fragments of the Heavenly Dao from ancient times are sealed, and the main body of the Heavenly Eye resides within.' He paused, adding, 'But that forbidden land is protected by nine layers of formations—even experts at the Tribulation Transcending realm cannot step half a stride within. Relying on this protection, the Heavenly Eye has covertly manipulated the world's fate for centuries.' Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward—there's no fortress in this world that cannot be breached, only chess games that aren't refined enough.

dialogue.content: Young Master Chen, long time no see.

text.content: Before the words finished, dark wind surged outside the window as a graceful figure stepped into the room riding demonic energy. Ye Qing wore a black dress whiter than snow, the mark of the Demonic Path Saint upon her brow even more enchanting than before. As demonic energy swirled around her, phoenix cries seemed to echo through the heavens. Apparently, in the turmoil at the Holy Sect, she not only restored her full cultivation but made further progress. She held a delicate jade bottle in her hand containing several pills emitting eerie auras, smiling as she offered them to Chen Ji: 'Heaven's Absolute Powder—the supreme toxin from the Holy Sect. A special gift I brought for Young Master Chen. This poison is colorless and odorless, capable of sealing all spiritual energy circulation—more than sufficient for dealing with the Heavenly Eye's guardians.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing blinked, her smile carrying a meaningful depth: 'Everything I saw in that prophecy... I've finally understood what the Holy Sect did to me. Three years as a cauldron, three years of blood sacrifice, three years of nascent soul refinement—it turns out my purpose was merely preparing a vessel for a chess piece.' Her voice turned cold: 'Since they showed no righteousness, don't blame me for in humanity. I now fully control the core secret technique of the Demonic Path's mist. If I wish, I can conceal anyone's Heavenly Secrets divination—including the Heavenly Eye.'

text.content: Chen Ji took the jade bottle, his fingertips lightly flickering as the cap opened silently. He leaned close and sniffed, his brow lifting slightly: 'Good stuff.' He then tucked the jade bottle into his sleeve, raising his eyes to look at Ye Qing: 'With Saint Ye's assistance, the Heavenly Eye will have to exert considerable effort to pry into our layout.' Upon hearing this, some of the coldness on Ye Qing's face faded, replaced by a playful smile: 'Young Master Chen's praise, Qing'er hardly deserves. There's something else though...' She lowered her voice, her gaze sweeping toward the window: 'The imperial court's interior is far from united. Though the Heavenly Eye is powerful, it still needs pawns to act on its behalf. Each of the nine layers of formations around the Hall of Heavenly Mandate requires a cave-void realm expert to sacrifice their life to unseal—and among the dynasty's three prime ministers and twelve generals, at least half are its puppets.'

Chen Ji's eyes suddenly lit up—that was the hunter's gleam triggered by spotting prey. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his voice calm as an ancient well without ripples: 'So we don't need to assault the Hall of Heavenly Mandate directly. We only need to turn those puppets against each other, to destabilize the dynasty's interior first—when the Heavenly Eye loses its pawns, it becomes a tiger without fangs.' Ye Qing clapped in appreciation: 'Young Master Chen truly has deep foresight.' However, Mo Xiansheng beside them shook his head: 'That may be so, but you've overlooked the most critical point—Ling Yuan.' At these words, the temperature in the room plummeted. Chen Ji's gaze turned dangerous: 'The old Sect Master?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried gravity: 'Correct. On the surface, he is a chess piece controlled by the Heavenly Eye, but this old man has observed him for decades and found his behavior patterns often conflict with the Heavenly Eye's will. He has his own ambitions—he wishes to replace the Heavenly Eye and become the new Heavenly Will.'

Upon hearing this, Chen Ji did not rage but laughed instead. That laughter echoed through the silent room, carrying hints of mockery and playfulness: 'Interesting. A successor chosen by the Heavenly Eye, yet harboring thoughts of devouring his master? Ling Yuan, ah Ling Yuan, I thought you were merely a loyal dog,没想到你是一条养不熟的狼。' His smile gradually faded, a fierce light flashing in his eyes: 'But this works too. The Heavenly Eye's enemies are our friends—at least until it's torn apart by Ling Yuan.' Ye Qing frowned: 'But Ling Yuan is the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. What if he turns back to the Heavenly Eye...' Chen Ji waved his hand: 'Rest assured, I have arrangements. He wants to become the Heavenly Will? I'll make him fall into eternal damnation. The debts from twenty years ago—it's time to collect.'

Just then, a servant's voice came from outside the door: 'Young Master, Han Batian, commander of the Demonic Path, requests an audience.' Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly: 'Han Batian? Why is that madman here?' Chen Ji said calmly: 'Please enter.' The door swung open, and a murderous aura swept into the room. Han Batian's form was majestic as a mountain, his features resolute yet carrying traces of ferocity, the scar running from his brow corner to his chin particularly jarring. He strode into the room, his gaze lingering on Ye Qing for a moment before shifting to Chen Ji, his voice thundering: 'Chen Ji, this one has come to fulfill the agreement from before.'

dialogue.content: Back when I was severely wounded, you promised—that if I survived, our forces would merge.

text.content: Chen Ji paused momentarily, then recalled that episode—when Ye Qing was on the brink of death, he had indeed spoken those words, never expecting Han Batian to remember so clearly. He calmly sized up the Demonic Path commander before him, seeing restrained brilliance in those eyes, an aura as deep as an abyss—this was clearly a peak expert one step from the Tribulation Transcending realm. Such a figure, if won over, would be an immense asset; but handled improperly, would be inviting a wolf into the house. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his ear: 'Han Batian is one of the chess pieces arranged by the Heavenly Eye, but he shares no subordination with the Heavenly Eye—merely a transaction. His terms can be accepted, but constraints must be set—otherwise, once the Heavenly Eye falls, he becomes a new disaster.'

Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then suddenly broke into a smile: 'Commander Han's proposal, Chen Ji naturally keeps in mind. However, regarding this word 'merge'—how does Commander Han interpret it?' Han Batian's gaze burned intensely: 'If the two of us strike together, who in the world can withstand a single blow from us? But if we act separately, we'll inevitably be defeated piecemeal. How about becoming sworn brothers—our forces under both banners merge into one, to scheme for great endeavors together!' Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's expression changed drastically. Just as she was about to speak and intervene, Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her. He stepped forward slowly, gazing at Han Batian, then suddenly extended his hand: 'Very well. But Chen Ji has one condition.'

Han Batian raised an eyebrow: 'Speak.' Chen Ji's smile turned deeply meaningful: 'On the day the Heavenly Eye is vanquished, Commander Han must integrate half of his Demonic Path disciples into my Heavenly Secrets Pavilion—failure to comply—' His voice suddenly turned cold: 'The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's assassination orders have never left anyone unpunished.' Han Batian froze for an instant, then burst into hearty laughter: 'Excellent! Excellent! I thought you were a softling,没想到是个带刺的！' He grasped Chen Ji's hand without hesitation. As demonic energy surged between their palms, an uncanny connection formed between the two. At this moment, the Demonic Path and the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion officially formed an alliance.

With the alliance forged, the atmosphere in the room eased somewhat. Yet Ye Qing furrowed her brow: 'Young Master Chen, when do we initiate the layout regarding the imperial court?' Chen Ji turned and walked to the window, gazing at the brightening sky beyond, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority: 'Three days from now, the Awakening Banquet in the capital.届时三大宗门、皇朝百官、魔道使者齐聚一堂——那便是我们揭开棋盘的时刻。' He turned back, his gaze sweeping across everyone present: 'Mo Xiansheng handles intelligence coordination, Ye Qing conceals the Heavenly Secrets, Han Batian provides deterrence—as for Ling Yuan...' A cold smile curved his lips: 'I'll personally pay my respects to this senior.'

The crowd dispersed to carry out their orders, and silence reclaimed the room. Chen Ji stood alone before the window, gazing at the dawn breaking over the eastern horizon, golden light swirling in his eyes. He slowly spread open his right hand, and the fifth page that had just awakened in his palm emanated a soft golden glow—the blank scroll now awaited his first stroke. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing out a drop of his essence blood, using spiritual energy as ink and heavenly secrets as the brush, writing the first rune upon that emptiness—the character 'Rebel'.
The moment the rune descended, heaven and earth lost their colors.

A blinding golden light erupted from Chen Ji's palm, soaring upward and enveloping the entire Tianqing Peak in resplendent brilliance. The radiance was so dazzling that even the rising sun paled in comparison. In the distance, countless disciples looked up in shock, unaware of what had occurred; yet in the depths of the imperial palace, something that had slumbered for centuries suddenly opened its eyes. They were pure white orbs without pupils—the Heavenly Eye itself. Sensing that rebellious aura, an ancient yet majestic voice echoed through the void: 'The fifth page... has awakened? Interesting. How many years has it been? Another ant dares to defy heaven.'

Chen Ji felt that gaze upon him and coldly smiled in his heart. His five fingers closed, drawing the golden light back into his body as the fifth page of the Tianji Record retreated into the depths of his bloodline. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his ear, carrying a note of warning: 'The Heavenly Eye has already noticed you. From now on, every thought you have, every action you take, falls under its surveillance—unless Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist conceals you.' Chen Ji replied indifferently: 'It matters not.' He turned toward the writing desk, dipping his brush to compose several secret letters, 'If it wishes to observe, let it observe. What I allow it to see is precisely what I intend for it to see.' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed: 'You are more of a chess player than Chen Xuan ever was.'

dialogue.content: Heavenly fate stirs, the chess game is set.

text.content: Chen Ji handed the secret letters to the shadow guards waiting outside, watching them vanish into the dawn. Everything was prepared—Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist, Han Batian's Demonic Path iron cavalry, Mo Xiansheng's intelligence network, and the first fate rune he had personally written. He raised his head, gazing at the crimson sun slowly rising, his eyes reflecting the boundless golden light, murmuring softly: 'Twenty years.' His voice was quiet yet carried an iron-like resolve, 'Father, Mother, this game—I will win it for you.' In the distance, from the direction of the Tianqing Sect's Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, a sudden violent spiritual energy fluctuation arose. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he looked up to see a familiar figure traversing the void toward him—it was the former Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan.

Ling Yuan's form halted ten zhang away from Chen Ji. That weathered old face betrayed no joy or anger, yet deep within those turbid eyes flickered a terrifying glint. His aura had grown even more profound and unpredictable than twenty years prior, resembling an ancient fierce beast in slumber, ready to devour at any moment. Chen Ji met his gaze, his expression serene as always, clasping his hands in salute: 'Disciple greets the Former Sect Master.' Ling Yuan offered no acknowledgment, simply staring at him for an extended moment before issuing a meaningful laugh: 'The fifth page has awakened? Excellent, excellent. This old man has waited for this day far too long.'

Chen Ji's gaze tightened imperceptibly, though his expression remained unmoved: 'The Former Sect Master's intelligence network is quite efficient.' Ling Yuan stroked his graying beard, his smile growing deeper: 'Do you truly believe this old man was unaware of your actions over these years? The Tianji Pavilion, the Shadow Guard Camp, colluding with the Demonic Path, secretly maneuvering among the three great sects—every deed, this old man has witnessed.' He stepped forward, his imposing presence suddenly surging, pressing down until even the surrounding air grew stagnant, 'This old man is merely curious about one thing—when do you plan to make your move against this old man?' Chen Ji fell silent for a moment before suddenly smiling: 'Former Sect Master jests. This disciple holds the deepest respect for you. What move could there possibly be?' Ling Yuan snorted coldly: 'Respect? This old man knows precisely what lies in your heart. The events of twenty years ago—do you think this old man is ignorant of them?'

Chen Ji's smile gradually faded, replaced by a bone-deep chill. He met Ling Yuan's gaze directly, his voice calm yet brimming with unmistakable sharpness: 'Since the Former Sect Master brings up twenty years ago, this disciple would like to ask—why did you stand by idly that night?' Ling Yuan's expression shifted subtly before returning to composure: 'This old man was gravely injured and recovering at the time, helpless to intervene.' Chen Ji scoffed: 'Gravely injured? This disciple recalls quite well that the Former Sect Master was in seclusion that very night, attempting a breakthrough—and the price of that breakthrough was using the essence blood of every member of the Chen family as a catalyst.' Ling Yuan's face sank completely, his personal pressure bearing down on Chen Ji like a mountain: 'What are you suggesting?' Chen Ji met that oppressive aura without the slightest fear, speaking word by word: 'I am saying—the Former Sect Master's Tribulation Realm cultivation was forged upon the bones and flesh of my Chen family.'

Ling Yuan's killing intent surged暴涨, yet the old man's voice carried an undertone of amusement: 'Chen Ji, do you believe your current strength permits you to berate this old man?' Chen Ji shook his head, his tone carrying a hint of pity: 'The Former Sect Master misunderstands. This disciple did not come today to settle old scores.' He paused, pivoting, 'This disciple merely wishes to inform the Former Sect Master of something—the Heavenly Eye has taken notice of you.' Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly. Chen Ji continued: 'Does it know that you intend to replace it as the new heavenly will?'

Ling Yuan fell silent. After a long while, he suddenly burst into laughter, the sound reverberating through the valley and startling countless birds: 'Excellent! Excellent, Chen Ji! No wonder the Tianji Record chose you—this cunning, this depth of scheming, far surpasses that deceased father of yours.' Chen Ji's face remained impassive. Ling Yuan ceased laughing, his eyes flashing with complex emotions: 'You wish for this old man to help you deal with the Heavenly Eye?' Chen Ji shook his head: 'No. This disciple wishes for the Former Sect Master to help himself.' He extended his hand, a small jade talisman materializing in his palm, 'This is a replica of the Tianji Record Fragment. It contains the method to break free from the Heavenly Eye's control—including the hidden restriction within your body.'

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply. Staring at that jade talisman, his breathing grew ragged: 'You...' Chen Ji tossed the jade talisman to Ling Yuan, who caught it reflexively. Chen Ji turned, his back to Ling Yuan, his voice faint: 'Consider it carefully, Former Sect Master. In three days, during the Awakening Banquet, each of us shall take what we need—you seek your heavenly will, while I seek causal freedom. Until then, we may cooperate temporarily.' He stepped forward, his voice drifting on the wind, 'As for whether that jade talisman is genuine or false... the Former Sect Master need only test it to know.' Ling Yuan clutched the jade talisman, gazing at Chen Ji's retreating figure, complex emotions flickering in his eyes. After a long moment, he lowered his head to examine his palm—the jade talisman bore an ancient rune, precisely the character 'Liberate' he had sought for decades.

When Chen Ji returned to his meditation chamber, dusk approached. He stood with hands clasped behind his back before the window, gazing at the blood-red晚霞 spreading across the horizon, a faint smile curling his lips. Everything proceeded according to plan—Ye Qing was in position, Han Batian had pledged support, Ling Yuan had been swayed, and the internal factions within the imperial dynasty had been seeded with shadow pieces. Mo Xiansheng's voice came from behind: 'Do you truly intend to spare Ling Yuan?' Chen Ji did not turn, his voice calm yet carrying bone-deep coldness: 'Spare? No. I merely intend to let him live a few more days.' He slowly turned, golden light swirling in his eyes, 'When the Heavenly Eye is destroyed, that will be Ling Yuan's date of execution. The blood debt from twenty years ago—I will make him repay it drop by drop.' Mo Xiansheng sighed: 'You have changed.' Chen Ji replied indifferently: 'People always change.'

Night fell. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on his meditation cushion, the fifth page at his brow center manifesting once more. He gazed at that blank scroll, fingers gently stroking the 'Rebel' rune, sensing the boundless power contained within. 'Rebel'—rebelling against heaven to alter fate, reversing chaos and causation, overturning life and death. This was the first rune he had written himself, the commencement of rewriting his own destiny. From now on, he would no longer be a piece to be moved by others, but the chess player making the moves. The Tianji Record slowly rotated within him, thoroughly merging with his bloodline. As golden light circulated, his aura rose to unprecedented heights—Foundation Building Late Stage, merely one step from Golden Core.

He slowly opened his eyes, golden radiance flickering briefly before vanishing. Soft knocking came from the chamber door, and Ye Qing's voice filtered through: 'Young Master Chen, everything is in position. The invitations to the Awakening Banquet have been delivered to all relevant powers.' Chen Ji rose and opened the door. Outside, Ye Qing stood beneath the moonlight in a black dress, behind her dozens of shadow guards with suppressed auras. He surveyed them all, his voice steady and powerful: 'Remember, at the Awakening Banquet, you have but one mission—protect yourselves and await my signal.' Ye Qing departed with her orders. Chen Ji stood alone in the courtyard, raising his head toward that cold, bright moon, and murmured: 'In three days, the world shall be thrown into chaos.' A meaningful curve played at the corner of his mouth, 'And this—is merely the beginning.'

Dawn broke, the horizon tinged with pale white. Chen Ji stood atop Tianqing Peak, morning wind billowing his robes. His gaze swept across the layers of clouds, settling upon the distant silhouette of the imperial capital. Behind him, Mo Xiansheng's phantom slowly materialized, also gazing in that direction, the ancient voice carrying a hint of emotion: 'Heavenly fate stirs, the chess game is set.' Chen Ji offered no response, simply watching silently. After a moment, he turned and departed, his figure stretched long by the rising sun. Upon the fifth page, that 'Rebel' rune radiated a gentle golden glow, as if proclaiming the dawn of a new era—an era written by his own hand, the era of Chen Ji.
